hypothesis: Requirement decomposition plus hybrid retrieval raises evidence Recall@5 by 15 points over V0 on jobs with four or more requirements.

ablations.name: Full Shipped Pipeline (Hybrid + Reranker + Claim Verify)

finding_summary: Key Finding on Retrieval vs. Reply Rate Disconnect: On 8.2% of jobs, achieving top evidence recall did not raise the client reply rate. Diagnostic error analysis revealed two primary causes: (1) Client Budget Mismatch: Highly qualified technical bids were rejected by low-budget clients prioritizing cheap labor over verified portfolio depth; (2) High Connects Saturation: On popular posts receiving 50+ proposals within minutes, simulated clients hired earlier applicants before evaluating later submissions regardless of evidence grounding.
